question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Dracula, Bob gets Jane Eyre, Claire gets Hamlet, Dave gets Candide, Eve gets Ivanhoe, Fred gets The Trial, and Gertrude gets Walden.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Alice and Dave swap books. Then, Dave and Alice swap books. Then, Gertrude and Dave swap books. Then, Dave and Eve swap books. Then, Fred and Dave swap books. Then, Dave and Gertrude swap books. Finally, Bob and Dave swap books. At the end of the semester, Claire has
Options:
(A) Dracula
(B) Jane Eyre
(C) Hamlet
(D) Candide
(E) Ivanhoe
(F) The Trial
(G) Walden
solution:
Owners in each row: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude
Initial: Dracula | Jane Eyre | Hamlet | Candide | Ivanhoe | The Trial | Walden
1. Alice ↔ Dave: Candide | Jane Eyre | Hamlet | Dracula | Ivanhoe | The Trial | Walden
2. Dave ↔ Alice: Dracula | Jane Eyre | Hamlet | Candide | Ivanhoe | The Trial | Walden
3. Gertrude ↔ Dave: Dracula | Jane Eyre | Hamlet | Walden | Ivanhoe | The Trial | Candide
4. Dave ↔ Eve: Dracula | Jane Eyre | Hamlet | Ivanhoe | Walden | The Trial | Candide
5. Fred ↔ Dave: Dracula | Jane Eyre | Hamlet | The Trial | Walden | Ivanhoe | Candide
6. Dave ↔ Gertrude: Dracula | Jane Eyre | Hamlet | Candide | Walden | Ivanhoe | The Trial
7. Bob ↔ Dave: Dracula | Candide | Hamlet | Jane Eyre | Walden | Ivanhoe | The Trial
Claire has Hamlet, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
